body.name: Width-two deterministic-path projection
body.construction: For \(b\le2\), set \(T^{\mathrm{proj}}=(W^{\mathrm{proj}},A^{\mathrm{proj}})\) with vertex set, uncertain-edge labels, and arcs from Definitions~\ref{def:transition-vertices}--\ref{def:transition-arcs}. Order bow vertices and uncertain-edge vertices by their endpoint tuples under \(\prec\), and initialize the prefixes \((\sigma,u_\beta)\) in that order. For a chordless prefix \(P=(\sigma,u_1,\ldots,u_k)\), form \(H(P)\) by deleting every unused vertex \(w\) with \(u_i\to w\in A^{\mathrm{proj}}\) for some \(i<k\); its children append, in \(\prec\)-order, each out-neighbor \(w\) of \(u_k\) in \(H(P)\) from which \(t\) is reachable in \(H(P)\). At \(t\), let \(U=L(P)\); emit \(U\) exactly when, for every \(e\in U\), the subgraph induced by \(\{u:L(u)\subseteq U\setminus\{e\}\}\) has no \(\sigma\)-to-\(t\) path, and when \(P\) is the \(\prec\)-least chordless path with label union \(U\), found by the same ordered reachability rule.
